reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and $360 for a pendant from an unknown brand is a lot when I'm spec-driven and my electrician needs UL listing, lumens and install details I can't see here. Ten to twelve business days and paying return shipping if I change my mind on a bulky fixture doesn't help.
objection: I don't know this brand, and nothing here shows UL listing, lumens or install specs, so I can't trust it's safe to hang in my house or that it looks like the photo.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with UL listing, lumens, dimensions and wiring details, plus real customer reviews with photos and free returns on a damaged or not-as-pictured fixture.
